prompt: Write a first-person account (about 120 words) by the driver for an insurance claim form. Accident: sideswipe while changing lanes in Katy, Texas. Injury: neck and back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1218; do not mention it.)
text: I was driving in the right lane on the main road in Katy, Texas, when I signaled and began moving left to change lanes. As I merged, the vehicle in the left lane came up beside me and its side made contact with my car's left front quarter panel. Both of us pulled onto the shoulder shortly afterward. I checked my mirrors and blind spot before moving over, so I believe the other driver was not paying attention to the lane. Neither of us was seriously moving at the time, and the impact felt like a hard scrape more than a crash. My car's left side is damaged, and the mirror housing is cracked. Later that day I began to feel stiffness and soreness in my neck and lower back, which has made it hard to sit and drive for long periods. I have started physical therapy and am following my doctor's instructions.
